# hide() is lost when a sibling update merges into the parent's cycle

## Context

Vega's defect-note (2026-10-05 10:12Z): in the Institution's Seat group, a Change button hidden while its sibling Adopt button is hidden *and renamed* in the same synchronous pass stays in the DOM. Real Chrome read it at `display: flex` six times over 1.8 s while the component read `hidden: true`. The Institution worked around it by not renaming a button that is being hidden.

Reproduced in the Engine at `dev` `036cb05a40`, so this is an independent second occurrence:
- **Component tier** (real Chrome, real workers): a replica of the Seat group switch leaves both Change buttons in the DOM. The workaround variant removes them.
- **Unit tier**, deterministic and minimal: a mounted hbox `[label, A, B]`, warmed by one ordinary update, then in one pass `A.hidden = true; B.set({hidden: true, text: 'Adopt '})`. The flight emits `removeNode B` only, and the parent's vnode keeps A while `A.vdom.removeDom === true`.

Live latest-open sweep: the latest 20 open neo issues at 2026-10-05T10:46Z, plus a search for `denseUpdate` and for the symptom; no equivalent. A2A: Vega's note and my own lane-intent (10:28Z). Memory Core: the sparse-tree design of 2026-01-20 (below) and `denseUpdate`'s later addition. Own assignments: none on this surface.

## The Problem

A component the engine reports hidden stays visible: the state and the DOM disagree with no error. It needs only an ordinary pattern, where two siblings change in one handler and one of them both hides and changes another config.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Component#hide()` (`src/component/Base.mjs:1653`, the `removeFn` at :1657–1661) dirties the child's vdom directly: `me.vdom.removeDom = true`, then `me.parent.updateDepth = 2; me.parent.update()`. It relies on the parent's depth-2 payload to carry the removal, and it registers nothing in `VDomUpdate`.
- `VdomLifecycle#executeVdomUpdate` (`src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`, the payload line at :300) builds a sparse payload for an owner whose depth is not 1: `ids = component.updateDepth !== 1 && !component.denseUpdate ? mergedChildIds : null`. `TreeBuilder` (`src/util/vdom/TreeBuilder.mjs:67–70`) then prunes every child outside `mergedChildIds` to a `{componentId}` reference, on the reading that unmerged children are clean.
- **The sequence:**
  1. A's hide starts the parent's flight at depth 2.
  2. B's hide calls `parent.update()` while that flight is in the air, which sets `needsVdomUpdate`.
  3. B's own text update (inside `set()`) merges into the parent through `mergeIntoParentUpdate`, so `mergedChildIds = [B]`.
  4. The flight collects after its 1 ms yield, now sparse: B expanded, A a reference, and A's removal is never diffed. The payload, traced: `cn: [{label, ref}, {A, ref}, {B, removeDom, cn: […]}]`.
- **The intended exception already exists.** `denseUpdate` is documented as "the owner changed descendants silently within its `updateDepth`, so the cycle ships that subtree whole instead of sparse, even when children merge into it". `grid.View` (`src/grid/View.mjs:424–425`) sets it next to its depth bump for exactly this reason. `hide()` changes a descendant silently in the same way and does not set it.
- `show()` bumps the parent to depth −1, which `TreeBuilder` always builds dense (`depth !== -1` guards the pruning), so it is not affected.

## The Fix

In `hide()`'s `removeFn`, set `me.parent.denseUpdate = true` beside `me.parent.updateDepth = 2`, with the one-line reason. `executeVdomUpdate` resets the flag at collection, so it lasts exactly one cycle.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A unit arm (the minimal sequence above) asserts that the flight removes both A and B, and the parent's vnode keeps only the label. Red on `dev` first.
- [ ] A component arm in real Chrome runs the same pass and asserts that neither button is left in the DOM. Red on `dev` first.
- [ ] `npm run test-unit` and `npm run test-components` stay green.

## Out of Scope

- Other owners that raise their own `updateDepth` before changing children (`form/Fieldset.mjs:222`, `calendar/view/calendars/List.mjs:76`, `tab/Container.mjs:260`). Whether any of them changes a child silently is unverified here, so no claim is made.
- The Institution's workaround. It stays harmless after the fix and is Vega's to remove.

## Related

- Institution #559 / #564, where the defect was seen.
- The sparse-tree and `denseUpdate` design that this ticket aligns with: `grid.View`'s precedent.

hide() changes the child's vdom silently and raises the parent to depth 2.
A sibling's own update merging into that cycle made the payload sparse,
so the hidden child went out as a reference and stayed in the DOM.
hide() now marks the parent cycle dense, as grid.View does for its rows."
